author: Nelev
body:
## Summary
- Fixes the hydration mismatch on the chat header: Clerk mounts `<UserButton />` into a host `div` on the client only, so when Clerk is already loaded at hydration the client tree had a `div` the server HTML lacked.
- Adds a small client `AccountMenu` that renders the button only after hydration, and uses it in `ChatHeader`.

## Test plan
- [x] `yarn lint`, `yarn format:check`, `yarn tsc --noEmit`
- [ ] Load `/` signed in with `yarn dev` and confirm no hydration error in the console
